regime: Risk-Off into the Fed, Indices Lose Their Stops, Crude Spikes
summary: No US data today, so the market spent the session positioning for the Fed. Stocks leaned defensive. NQ drifted lower all day, lost its trend stop, printed a 28,919 low, then bounced late to close 28,987, down 0.71 percent. ES tracked it lower, down 0.47 percent to 7,596, also under its stop. The big mover was crude. MCL ripped 3.6 percent to 105.52 in the day session and flipped its stop up. December gold held about flat, down 0.16 percent to 4,333, and edged back above its own stop. VIX barely moved near 17.2. The Fed decides tomorrow at 2:00 pm ET with fresh projections, and August retail sales lands the same morning.

event.name: No scheduled US release (FOMC day 1 of 2)
event.actual: There was no scheduled US release today, so the driver was positioning ahead of the Fed. That changes tomorrow. The FOMC rate decision and a fresh set of economic projections land Wednesday September 16 at 2:00 pm ET, and Advance Retail Sales for August prints at 8:30 am ET the same morning. The current target range is 3.50 to 3.75 percent, and the market is split on a hold versus a small hike, so the projections and the press conference matter as much as the decision itself.
event.surprise: Stocks leaned defensive into the decision. NQ and ES both lost their trend stops, crude jumped over 3 percent, December gold held about flat and edged back above its stop, and VIX was little changed near 17.2.
event.nqReaction: NQ opened into a tight 71 point range, broke down out of it at 29,050, and sold to a 28,919 low before a late bounce to close 28,987, below NYVWAP 28,992 and below its reset trend stop.
event.crossAsset: December gold slipped 0.16 percent to 4,333 but reclaimed its stop. Crude ripped 3.6 percent to 105.52 in the day session and flipped its stop up. MGC1! October settled 4,299.9. VIX near 17.2, up about half a percent.

risk.sizing: The indices lost their stops and the Fed decides tomorrow at 2:00 pm ET, so this is a keep it small backdrop that leans defensive into the decision. Consider standing flat or trimming risk around the 2:00 pm release. This is not a size up spot.
risk.openRisk: For the indices the reset stops are the line. NQ is below 29,154 and ES below 7,620, so both carry a with-trend short lean until they reclaim those stops on two hourly closes. Downside references are today's 28,919 NQ low and 7,577 ES low, then lower. Upside references are the 29,199 overnight high and 29,500 on NQ, and 7,633 then 7,700 on ES. December gold reclaimed its 4,306 stop and closed 4,333, a with-trend long lean while it holds 4,306, with 4,350 and 4,400 above. Crude reclaimed its 103.78 stop and closed 105.52, a with-trend long while it holds 103.78, with today's 106.75 high above and the 105 area as the pivot.
risk.note: Very high event risk into the FOMC decision Wednesday September 16 at 2:00 pm ET with fresh projections, plus August retail sales at 8:30 am ET. A binary event can whip both ways, so keep size small and mind prop news blackout rules around the 2:00 pm decision. Not financial advice.

psychology: This is the hardest kind of day to sit still. The Fed decides tomorrow, so nothing today was going to settle the trend, and a slow grind lower with a sharp crude spike is exactly the tape that tempts you to overtrade. The edge tonight is preparation. Mark your levels, size down, and let the 2:00 pm decision come to you. If you are already short the indices with the trend, that is fine, but do not add risk into a binary event. Whatever the Fed says, the reaction can whip both ways in minutes. Flat is a position, and tomorrow rewards the trader who kept powder dry.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN
fullReport.html: NQ opened into a tight 71 point range at the bell: high 29,146, low 29,075. Price broke down out of that range at 29,050 and worked lower through the session to a 28,919 low, closing 28,987, below NYVWAP 28,992. In plain terms the market opened, failed to hold the range, and drifted lower into the Fed. For Wednesday the opening range resets fresh, but it is the FOMC decision day. HOF and MID sit out Wednesday and the Fed decision. BIR and BNC are eligible by calendar, though the 2:00 pm ET decision and 8:30 am retail sales make it a high-risk session, so treat any opening-range play with extra caution. Calendar: FOMC rate decision and fresh projections Wednesday September 16 at 2:00 pm ET, and Advance Retail Sales for August at 8:30 am ET the same morning. Conditional and educational only.

fullReport.title: Momentum Breakout (Regime Filter)
fullReport.html: E3v2 Momentum Long is off on the indices. NQ and ES both closed below their trend stops, so the index momentum long filter is not armed and there is no long there. Crude is the opposite, above its stop after a 3.6 percent breakout, so a momentum long filter is on for crude, but it just ran hard and the Fed lands tomorrow, so chasing it is poor risk. For a fresh index breakout long, this is a stand-aside spot until price reclaims the stops.

fullReport.title: AVWAP Deviation Band Reversal
fullReport.html: AVWAP deviation band (MNQ): AVWAP center 28,978, close 28,987 sits about half a sigma above the mean. Bands: plus 2 sigma 29,011, plus 1 sigma 28,994, minus 1 sigma 28,961, minus 2 sigma 28,945, minus 3 sigma 28,928. Sigma is tight at about 16 because the hourly closes clustered even though the session range was wide, from 28,919 to 29,136. Volume is unavailable on the continuous contract, so this is price only. There is no stretched extreme to fade right now, and these bands are unusually narrow, so a Fed-driven move tomorrow will run through them. This edge is a low-value fade until volatility and the bands re-expand.
